text: Ilse's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is at St Mary's on 4 November. I'd like to go if I can get the afternoon off.

Tendai has been made redundant after eleven years at the depot. He found out on the 14th and finishes on 30 November 2026. He's putting a brave face on it but he's clearly rattled. His wife works part time at the school, and their two boys are both at college, so money is going to be tight over Christmas. He's thinking about driving for one of the delivery firms in the meantime.
Aditi is knitting a blanket for her sister's baby, due in March 2027. Moss stitch, sage green. She's already halfway through.
Remind me to text Kemal on 12/11 to wish him luck at his darts final. He's nervous because his old team will be there.
Leah and her boyfriend Ryan have split up. She moved back in with her mum last weekend.
Mehmet supports Galatasaray and watches every match at the Turkish café on Green Lanes. His son Idris is a Fenerbahçe fan, which causes trouble.
Need to buy a sympathy card for Elena. Her grandmother died on 9th October, aged 96.
Bridget's daughter Nora graduates from Leeds on 17 July 2027. Bridget is already planning what to wear.
Buy stamps, post the parcel to Mum, and book the boiler service before the 1st.
Malik plays bass in a Northern Soul covers band. They have a gig at the Fleece on 22 November.

Nikolai's brother Ivan is coming over from Sofia on 3rd of December and staying until the new year. Nikolai is a bit anxious about having him in the flat that long. They haven't lived together since they were teenagers, and Ivan still smokes indoors. Nikolai has booked them tickets for the ice hockey on 10 December to give them something to do together.
Florin collects vintage Romanian football programmes. He's hunting for a Steaua 1986 European Cup final one, which would make a great Christmas present if I ever see one.

Yosef said the wedding is off. He and Saskia broke up in September and he's still very low about it. Apparently she'd been having doubts since the summer and finally told him after her brother's wedding. He's had to cancel the venue and lost the deposit. He's been throwing himself into his climbing, three or four times a week at the wall. I should invite him round for dinner one evening next week.
Eduardo's mum has her hip operation on 6 Nov. He's taking the week off to look after her.

Lovely long chat with Kasia this morning. Her husband Henrik has just been told his job at the bank is going in the January restructure, so they're looking at whether she goes back full time. Their eldest, Finn, starts secondary school next September and they'd hoped to move nearer the good school before then, but that's on hold now. She sounded tired but not panicked. Don't forget to send her that budgeting spreadsheet.
Kiara is obsessed with the new Zelda game. She's already put 80 hours in.
Agnieszka mentioned her cat Pierogi went missing on Friday. She's put posters up all round the estate. Must check the alleyway behind our garage.
Colm is running the Dublin marathon again next year, 25 October 2027. Training starts properly in May.

Isabel's uncle died last month and she's flying to Lisbon for the memorial on the 2nd of November. He was the one who taught her to play the guitar, so she's been asked to play something at the service. She's practising every night and says she's dreading it. She's back on the 6th.
Milan and Adriana are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 19 May. Adriana wants to keep it low key, just a meal somewhere nice.
Olga's son Amir passed his driving test today on his third attempt! She was so relieved.
Lior is learning the cello at 52. Lessons every Thursday, and he practises before work.
I'm doing the flowers for Tendai's father's funeral on Saturday. Ivan is driving us there.
Saskia Olsen got the redundancy letter yesterday. Meeting with HR on 28/10. I should ring her the night before to talk it through.
Finally finished the jigsaw. 2000 pieces, took three weeks.
Ryan's band split up after the drummer moved to Glasgow. He's selling his amp and thinking about going solo.
Henrik is a huge Brentford fan, season ticket holder since 1998. His wife says he's impossible to live with when they lose.
Note to self: Ilse's mum turns 80 on 8 January 2027. Ilse is organising a surprise lunch and wants me to help with invitations. Need to message her cousin Leah about the guest list.
Elena Gonzalez, Lena to everyone, is starting a pottery course at the community centre on Tuesday evenings. She wants to make her own mugs.
Rang Kemal. His father's stone setting is on 15 March 2027, a year after the funeral. He's finding the anniversary approach harder than he expected.

Aditi's husband lost his job at the agency in August and still hasn't found anything. She's covering everything and the stress is showing. Their daughter Kasia has just started at Manchester, so there are fees on top of the mortgage. Aditi says knitting is the only thing keeping her sane at the moment. I need to check in with her properly, maybe a walk on Sunday.
Don't forget Idris's birthday on 27th of October. He's into astronomy, so maybe a star map or a decent pair of binoculars.
Colm's birthday drinks on Friday have been cancelled because half the group has flu. He's rescheduling for 7 November instead.
Mehmet said the redundancy meeting went better than he thought. They've offered him a different role in Bristol. I must ask him next week whether he's taking it.
Bridget breeds Border terriers and her dog Hattie had a litter of five on Monday. She's keeping one, a little brown girl called Fig.
Malik's grandmother is ninety on 1 December. The whole family is going to Lahore for it, flying out on the 26th of November.
Kiara said her parents are getting divorced. She's fine about it, apparently, but her little brother isn't taking it well.
Book the car in for its MOT, sometime before 14/11.
Florin and his wife Adriana are hosting Romanian Christmas on 24 December. I'm bringing the wine.
Nikolai says Ivan finally got into the Bolshoi training programme. He starts in September 2027.
Agnieszka's partner Olga is a paediatric nurse and works nights, so evenings are the best time to catch her.
Isabel is really into Kate Bush at the moment. She's got all the vinyl except Lionheart. Gift idea.
Need to call Yosef on 2nd December. That's when the house sale goes through and he'll be on his own for the first time since the separation.

Spoke to Amir after the funeral. His uncle was only 58. Amir's aunt is staying with them for now, and the kids are taking it hard. He said the best thing would be just to keep inviting him out, not to make a big deal of it. I'll take him to the snooker on the 9th.
Kasia's sister Nora is pregnant with twins, due 30 April 2027. Kasia is going to be an auntie for the first time and is beside herself.
Lior plays in a Sunday league chess club and just won the regional rapid tournament.
Henrik's last day at the bank is 31 January 2027. They're doing leaving drinks on the 29th. I should find out whether everyone's chipping in for a gift.
Quiet one today. Nothing much to report.

Leah said her brother Finn has broken up with his fiancée three weeks before the wedding. Her parents had already paid for the venue. The wedding was meant to be 14 November 2026 at a barn near Ludlow. Finn has moved into Leah's spare room for now and spends most evenings playing FIFA with her boyfriend. She says he's eating, which is something.
Idris is building a model railway in his loft. OO gauge, a 1950s Cornish branch line. He's spent two years on the scenery alone.
Tendai's wife Kiara has her first scan on 5/11. They haven't told anyone at work yet.
Eduardo wants to see Benfica play at the Estádio da Luz before he turns 40, which is 12 August 2027. Might be worth looking into a trip.
Text Ilse after the funeral on 4 November to see how she's holding up. Maybe drop round with soup that weekend.
Milan's dog Bruno had to be put to sleep yesterday. He'd had him fourteen years. Milan sounded completely flat.

Caught up with Bridget, Colm and their son Ryan at the garden centre. Ryan has his grade 5 piano exam on 18 November and is terrified of the sight-reading part. Colm has been made redundant from the council but says he's actually relieved; he's going to retrain as an electrician from January. Bridget is still doing her watercolours and has a piece in the village show on 30th of November. I should send Ryan a good luck message the day before.
Saskia's mother has early dementia. She's been diagnosed this summer and Saskia is going up to Newcastle every other weekend.
Adriana is mad about crochet amigurumi. She's made a whole set of the Moomins for her niece.
I'm going to the Wolves away game on 21 December with Malik and his brother Kemal. Malik's driving.

Mrs Usman next door said her son Amir and his wife are moving to Dubai on 15 January 2027. She's trying to be positive but she's going to miss the grandchildren terribly. I must pop round more often after they go.

Olga mentioned that her ex-husband remarried in June. She took it better than I'd have expected. She's been going to a salsa class on Wednesdays since the spring and says it's done wonders for her confidence. Her daughter Elena is getting married herself in August 2027, and Olga is determined to enjoy it.
